invariants.rationale: The reduction with zeroValue should always yield a non-null result since zeroValue is required as an identity.
This method never assigns to data and expects a valid HoodieData input.
The reduce operation requires seqOp to be non-null.
The reduce operation requires combOp to be non-null.
The zeroValue is required as the identity for reduction, and null would typically not be a valid identity.
